instruction: On the Find Jobs page, use the company dropdown in the sidebar to filter jobs by 'Nimbus Cloud Technologies'. How many jobs are shown for that company?

Search for jobs containing the keyword 'platform' using the search bar. How many results are returned?
Use the semantic search API to find jobs related to 'cloud infrastructure devops'. How many results are returned?
Search for jobs with the keyword 'distributed' and report the title of the first result when sorted by relevance.
Use semantic search to find jobs related to 'developer tools open source'. How many of the results mention 'Go' or 'Rust' in their requirements?
On the Find Jobs page, use the company dropdown to filter jobs from 'Sentry.io'. What is the salary range for their listed position?
On the Find Jobs page, use the Job Type radio buttons in the sidebar to filter for 'full-time' jobs only. How many full-time jobs are listed?
On the Find Jobs page, use the salary slider to filter for jobs with a minimum salary of at least $160,000. How many jobs meet this criterion?
Filter jobs to show only those posted between 2026-05-01 and 2026-05-31 using the date range filters. How many jobs were posted in May 2026?
Sort all jobs by salary from highest to lowest. What is the title of the highest-paying job?
Search for 'Kubernetes' and report the company name of the first result.
